title: NHSRC Notification 2026 - Apply online for Consultant Posts
description: The National Health Systems Resource Centre (NHSRC) has released a notification to fill 1 vacancy for a Consultant position. Candidates who have qualified in MBBS, BDS, BAMS, BHMS, or post-graduation can grab this chance and apply for the NHSRC Notification 2026 . Here, we have included the age limit, selection process, salary structure, education details, application fee, and how to apply for these posts. Interested and eligible candidates can apply online before the last date of application...
